A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with the corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-blizzard1-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Blizzard 1 (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 19 November 2016): The wording returns to the 2013 slip's: “Landspeed may not be increased.” is again the third sentence, and “cannon” is lower case. As a slip it again has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip, and the bronze disc is gone.

The same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width, and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
